name: sam-gov-opportunities-scraper
title: SAM.gov Scraper – Contracts, Wage Determinations & Grants
description: Scrape live US federal contracting opportunities from SAM.gov — solicitations, sources sought and awards — plus wage determinations, CFDA grant/loan programs and organization-only exclusion records, with no API key and no login.
